title: By Faith, or by Works of the Law? The Righteous Shall Live by Faith

questions.question: O ____ Galatians! Who has bewitched you? It was before your eyes that Jesus Christ was publicly portrayed as crucified.
questions.explanation: Galatians 3:1 (ESV): "O foolish Galatians! Who has bewitched you? It was before your eyes that Jesus Christ was publicly portrayed as crucified."

questions.question: Paul asks them: "Did you receive the Spirit by works of the law or by ____?"
questions.explanation: Galatians 3:2 (ESV): "Let me ask you only this: Did you receive the Spirit by works of the law or by hearing with faith?"

questions.question: "Are you so foolish? Having begun by the Spirit, are you now being perfected by the ____?"
questions.explanation: Galatians 3:3 (ESV): "Are you so foolish? Having begun by the Spirit, are you now being perfected by the flesh?"

questions.question: Just as Abraham "believed God, and it was counted to him as ____"—
questions.explanation: Galatians 3:6 (ESV): "just as Abraham 'believed God, and it was counted to him as righteousness'—"

questions.question: Know then that it is those of faith who are the ____ of Abraham.
questions.explanation: Galatians 3:7 (ESV): "Know then that it is those of faith who are the sons of Abraham."

questions.question: The Scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, preached the gospel beforehand to Abraham, saying, "In you shall all the nations be ____."
questions.explanation: Galatians 3:8 (ESV): "And the Scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, preached the gospel beforehand to Abraham, saying, 'In you shall all the nations be blessed.'"

questions.question: For all who rely on works of the law are under a ____; for it is written, "Cursed be everyone who does not abide by all things written in the Book of the Law, and do them."
questions.explanation: Galatians 3:10 (ESV): "For all who rely on works of the law are under a curse; for it is written, 'Cursed be everyone who does not abide by all things written in the Book of the Law, and do them.'"

questions.question: Now it is evident that no one is justified before God by the law, for "The righteous shall live by ____."
questions.explanation: Galatians 3:11 (ESV): "Now it is evident that no one is justified before God by the law, for 'The righteous shall live by faith.'"

questions.question: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law by becoming a curse for us—for it is written, "Cursed is everyone who is ____"
questions.explanation: Galatians 3:13 (ESV): "Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law by becoming a curse for us—for it is written, 'Cursed is everyone who is hanged on a tree'—"

questions.question: Now the promises were made to Abraham and to his offspring. It does not say, "And to offsprings," referring to many, but referring to one, "And to your offspring," who is ____.
questions.explanation: Galatians 3:16 (ESV): "Now the promises were made to Abraham and to his offspring. It does not say, 'And to offsprings,' referring to many, but referring to one, 'And to your offspring,' who is Christ."

questions.question: The law, which came how many years afterward, does not annul a covenant previously ratified by God, so as to make the promise void.
questions.explanation: Galatians 3:17 (ESV): "This is what I mean: the law, which came 430 years afterward, does not annul a covenant previously ratified by God, so as to make the promise void."

questions.question: Why then the law? It was added because of ____, until the offspring should come to whom the promise had been made.
questions.explanation: Galatians 3:19 (ESV): "Why then the law? It was added because of transgressions, until the offspring should come to whom the promise had been made..."

questions.question: So then, the law was our ____ until Christ came, in order that we might be justified by faith.
questions.explanation: Galatians 3:24 (ESV): "So then, the law was our guardian until Christ came, in order that we might be justified by faith." (Some translations say tutor or schoolmaster, ESV says guardian)

questions.question: For as many of you as were baptized into Christ have ____.
questions.explanation: Galatians 3:27 (ESV): "For as many of you as were baptized into Christ have put on Christ."

questions.question: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free, there is no male and female, for you are all ____ in Christ Jesus.
questions.explanation: Galatians 3:28 (ESV): "There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free, there is no male and female, for you are all one in Christ Jesus."

key_verse_text: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free, there is no male and female, for you are all one in Christ Jesus.
